sentences.text: 4. Learned APP for State has appeared on advance Notice.

5. An Interim Protection is sought on behalf of the Petitioner which is vehemently contested on behalf of the Complainant on the grounds that there is serious property disputes between the family members.
There are serious allegations of manipulation of Will dated 02.11.2023 which was registered after his demise.

The deceased Nitin Arora had been forcibly removed by the Petitioner on LAMA from Max Hospital and thereafter, was admitted in a non-descripted small clinic by the name of Pushpanjali on 21.11.2024 and he died on 25.11.2025.
6. It is asserted that Section 304(II) IPC has also been added since the Petitioner who is the wife,
had deprived him of the adequate medical assistance and had forcibly taken him to her house.
It is thus, submitted that the Interim Protection be not granted.
7. Learned APP for State also submits that the offence of Section 304(II) IPC has been added.

8. Learned Senior Advocate on behalf of the Petitioner argues that there is nothing suspicious in the execution of Will by the deceased, a few days before his demise when he faced the imminent death on account of Cancer.
It is further submitted that it is only after dismissal of the Anticipatory Bail Application by learned ASJ, that Section 304(II) IPC has been added.
9. It is, therefore, submitted that the entire FIR is malafide which has been filed to deprive the Petitioner of her legitimate rights to the properties of her deceased husband.
Furthermore, Shivani who is the sister-in-law of This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 08/12/2025 at 21:08:47 the Applicant has sold the mother-in-law's share in the undivided property and has, therefore, been perpetuated against the Petitioner.
It is further asserted that the money realized from the sale of share of mother-in-law, has been credited to the account of sister-in-law.

Submissions heard and record perused.
10.
Considering the totality of circumstances, no Interim Protection is warranted in the present case.

However, the Investigating Officer shall conduct the investigations in accordance with the provisions of BNSS.
11.
The Status Report be filed on behalf of the State before the next date of hearing with copy of the same to the opposite counsel.

12. List on 22.12.2025.
NEENA BANSAL KRISHNA, J DECEMBER 5, 2025/va
